table.retrieve:
select   
	glheader.glvochcode,
	glheader.vouchercode,
	gldetail.debit,
	gldetail.credit, 
	date = glheader.date,
	type = 	RTRIM(LTRIM((SELECT V.SHORTNAME 
				FROM vochercategory v 
				WHERE v.vochcatcode = glheader.vochcatcode))) + '-' +		
		RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), glheader.glvochcode))),  
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = glheader.acccode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = gldetail.acccode),
	invoicecode=gldetail.invoicecode,
	invoicedate = (SELECT SL.Date FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.SaleInvcode = gldetail.invoicecode),
	SalesMan = (SELECT SM.Name FROM Salesman SM WHERE SM.Salesmancode = glheader.smancode),
	posted = glheader.posted
from
	glheader,
	gldetail		 	
where    
	glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and
	gldetail.credit > 0 AND
	glheader.vochcatcode IN (2, 4, 12, 13) and glheader.acccode <> gldetail.acccode and 
	(glheader.date >= :ad_StartDate) and
	(glheader.date <= :ad_endDate) 
union all
select   
	glvochcode=SaleLedger.SaleInvCode,
	invoicecode=SaleLedger.HeaderInvNo,
	debit=0,
	credit=SaleLedger.amt, 
	date = SaleLedger.date,
	type = 'SV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), SaleLedger.SaleInvCode))),  
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = SaleLedger.PaymentAccCode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = SaleLedger.CustCode),
	invoicecode=SaleLedger.SaleInvCode,
	invoicedate = SaleLedger.Date,
	SalesMan = (SELECT SM.Name FROM Salesman SM WHERE SM.Salesmancode = SaleLedger.smancode),
	posted = SaleLedger.posted
from
	SaleLedger
where    
	SaleLedger.amt <> 0 AND
	SaleLedger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
union all
select   
	glvochcode=PRLedger.PRInvCode,
	invoicecode=PRLedger.HeaderInvNo,
	debit=0,
	credit=PRLedger.amt, 
	date = PRLedger.date,
	type = 'PR-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), PRLedger.PRInvCode))),  
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = PRLedger.PaymentAccCode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = PRLedger.SuppCode),
	invoicecode=PRLedger.PRInvCode,
	invoicedate = PRLedger.Date,
	SalesMan = NULL,
	posted = PRLedger.posted
from
	PRLedger
where    
	PRLedger.amt <> 0 AND
	PRLedger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
union all
select   
	glvochcode=Notes.NoteCode,
	invoicecode=NULL,
	debit=0,
	credit=Notes.amount, 
	date = Notes.duedate,
	type = 'NR-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), Notes.NoteCode))),  
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = Notes.AccCode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = Notes.BankAccCode),
	invoicecode=NULL,
	invoicedate = NULL,
	SalesMan = NULL,
	posted = Notes.posted
from
	Notes
where    
	Notes.NoteCatCode=1 AND
	Notes.duedate BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
order by
	date,
	type,
	accountname,
	accounthead
table.sort: date A, type A, accountname A, accounthead A
